title: National Waterway 101 _Tizu and Zungki Rivers:
text:
101. National Waterway 101 _Tizu and Zungki Rivers:_
Longmatra at Lat 25[o]46‟12”N, Lon 94[o]44‟35”E to Avanghku at
Myanmar border Lat 25[o]35‟03”N, Lon 94[o]53‟06”E and in Zungki
river from bridge at Lat 25[o]48‟26”N, Lon 94[o]46‟36”E to
confluence of Zungki and Tizu rivers at Lat 25[o]46‟58”N, Lon
94[o]45‟21”E.
